name: chrt
long_description:
chrt is a logistics platform for time-critical shipping. We enable businesses to deliver their most critical items same-day.

Time-Critical Logistics is a $30B market growing at a 20% CAGR driven by growth in American healthcare and manufacturing.

Businesses that place time-critical orders are enterprises who have urgent items they need to deliver ASAP. These orders are critical in nature and often require white glove service -- think therapeutic treatments for healthcare providers or specialized equipment for manufacturers. 

chrt builds the software for forwarders and professional couriers who pick up and deliver these orders. Couriers use chrt to coordinate and track their shipments, including a driver app and fleet management tools. Forwarders use chrt to dispatch couriers, book flights, and track time-critical orders from start to finish. Shippers use chrt to place these orders with their providers and to monitor everything. 

In addition, we also sell physical tracking devices that can be used to track valuable cargo or assets.

This gives us full control of the shipment and allows us to provide shippers with end-to-end tracking. It also allows us to intervene early if we notice something is going wrong.

We’re software engineers that became friends years ago at McKinsey. Kyle is an expert in Time-Critical Logistics, having led strategy at a leader in the space. Aaron is an expert at designing and implementing AI systems to handle complex coordination. We were shipping code together on nights and weekends for years before chrt; now we’re also shipping freight.

launches.title: 📦 chrt – Logistics Platform for Time-Critical Shipping
launches.tagline: We enable businesses to deliver their most critical items same-day with full visibility
launches.body:
Hi everyone! We are [Kyle](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kyle-reagan-surfs/) and [Aaron](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aaroncarver/), co-founders of [chrt.com](https://chrt.com). We’re helping businesses deliver and track their most critical same-day shipments.

https://youtu.be/EJfOqCY06rw

**🎯 Who is it for?**

* Industrial manufacturers and healthcare companies that need white-glove, same- or next-day delivery with live tracking — for shipments such as life‑saving therapeutics or mission‑critical production parts
* Courier companies and freight forwarders that want to provide their customers with end-to-end tracking and custom workflows

**⛔️ Problem:**

* Businesses shipping critical items depend on outdated freight forwarders
* Two-thirds of these forwarders’ staff are call-center agents coordinating shipments across thousands of professional courier companies
* Call center agents rely on phone and email to reach couriers
* With no real-time tracking, shipment status is unknown, causing frequent failures and delays
* Your life-or-death shipment? Tracked worse than a pizza

**✅ Solution:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90745&key=user_uploads/1381778/dc006314-7ec3-4274-afff-89ca44a92b31)

chrt is the all-in-one platform for time-critical logistics

* 📦 Businesses place urgent shipments on [**chrt.com**](http://chrt.com)
* 🚛 chrt matches a vetted provider for pickup and delivery
* 📱 Couriers execute the job entirely through chrt’s mobile app
* 📍 Real-time tracking and custom workflows provide complete shipment visibility
* ⚡ Automation slashes overhead, delivering faster, cheaper, and more reliable service

**🙋‍♂️ About us:**

We’re software engineers that became friends years ago at McKinsey. Kyle is an expert in time-critical logistics, having led strategy at a leading startup in the space. Aaron led gen AI deployment projects at Deloitte, launching AI projects for clients like the Department of Defense. We were shipping code together on nights and weekends for years before CHRT; now we’re also shipping freight.

**🙌 How to help us:**

**If you have or handle time-critical shipments (or know someone who does) we would love to get connected**. We’ll help you ship your most complex and important orders same-day.

📧 Email us: [**founders@chrt.com**](mailto:founders@chrt.com)
